description: This file contains instrumentation functions for various web frameworks, HTTP libraries, and databases using OpenTelemetry. It defines methods to instrument FastAPI, Flask, requests, httpx, SQLAlchemy, SQLite, Redis, and placeholders for DB API and OpenAI integrations, primarily for tracing and monitoring purposes.

methods.name: _decode_body
methods.description: Decodes a request or response body from bytes to UTF-8 string, with exception handling.

methods.name: _instrument_fastapi
methods.description: Instruments FastAPI to add tracing hooks for request and response bodies.

methods.name: _instrument_requests
methods.description: Instruments the requests library to add tracing for HTTP headers and bodies.

methods.name: _instrument_httpx
methods.description: Instruments the httpx library to add tracing for HTTP requests and responses, including creating instrumented client classes.

methods.name: _instrument_flask
methods.description: Instruments Flask to add tracing for incoming HTTP requests and responses.

methods.name: _instrument_sqlalchemy
methods.description: Instruments SQLAlchemy to trace database queries, including capturing query results for SELECT statements.

methods.name: _instrument_dbapi
methods.description: Placeholder for instrumenting generic DB API; currently not implemented.

methods.name: _instrument_sqlite3
methods.description: Placeholder for instrumenting sqlite3; currently not implemented.

methods.name: _instrument_redis
methods.description: Instruments Redis client to trace commands and responses.

methods.name: _instrument_openai
methods.description: Placeholder for instrumenting OpenAI API calls; currently not implemented.

methods.name: apply_instrumentation
methods.description: Main function that applies all available instrumentation functions for various frameworks and libraries.
